# Catalyst - Turn Notes Into Knowledge

Catalyst is an open-source web application designed to automatically turn raw, local markdown notes into an interconnected knowledge graph and active-recall flashcards. 
It supports writing in any editor and syncs your local folder to a powerful spaced repetition system. 

## Core Features
- Local-first note syncing (syncs raw markdown files).
- Auto-generation of flashcards and knowledge graphs from notes.
- Spaced repetition study mode.
- PWA support with offline caching capabilities.

## Architecture
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, CSS Modules / Global CSS
- Database/Auth: Supabase
- Algorithms: SuperMemo 2 (SM-2) for spaced repetition

For more information, please refer to the live site at https://catalyst-jet.vercel.app/
